verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪੇਖੈ ਸਿਆਮ ਘਟਾ ਗਗਨ ਘਮੰਡ ਘੋਰ ਮੋਰ ਅਉ ਪਪੀਹਾ ਸੁਭ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਨਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise pekhai siaam ghaTaa gagan ghama(n)dd ghor mor aau papeehaa subh sabadh sunaavahee ||

en.bdb: Just as peacocks and rain-birds make pleasing sounds seeing the dark clouds in the sky and hearing their thunder.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਬਸੰਤ ਸਮੈ ਮਉਲਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਆਂਬ ਕੋਕਿਲਾ ਮਧੁਰ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਨਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau basa(n)t samai maulat anek aa(n)b kokilaa madhur dhun bachan sunaavahee ||

en.bdb: Just as mango and many other trees bloom during spring season, when cuckoos become ecstatic and make very sweet sounds sitting on these trees.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਰਫੁਲਤ ਕਮਲ ਸਰੁਵਰ ਵਿਖੈ ਮਧੁਪ ਗੁੰਜਾਰਤ ਅਨੰਦ ਉਪਜਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise parafulat kamal saruvar vikhai madhup gu(n)jaarat ana(n)dh upajaavahee ||

en.bdb: Just as lotus flowers bloom in a pond attracting bumble bees who come flying making pleasant sound.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਪੇਖਿ ਸ੍ਰੋਤਾ ਸਾਵਧਾਨਹ ਗਾਇਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਹੀ ॥੫੬੭॥
verses.translit_en: taise pekh srotaa saavadhaaneh gain gaavai pragaTai pooran prem sahaj samaavahee ||567||

en.bdb: Similarly, seeing the listeners sitting in singular mind, the singers sing the divine hymns in deep devotion and attention that creates an atmosphere of loving tranquility absorbing both the singers and the listeners in divine state of ecstasy.  (567)
